articles.summary: Teradata announced that it has acquired Stemma Technologies, a cloud-native, fully managed, data catalog solution. Stemma is recognized for its innovation and adept use of AI and machine learning that helps users discover, trust, and use their data and metadata more effectively.
articles.title: Teradata Acquires Stemma, Adding AI Technology and Talent to Accelerate Transformative Analytics Value for Customers
